meta.title: Family Cookbook
meta.description: Collect and cook family recipes together—ingredients, steps, photos, and translations in one private cookbook.

home.title: Family Cookbook
home.subtitle: Keep your family's recipes together—easy to read at the stove and shared only with people you invite.
home.bulletCollect: Save ingredients, steps, notes, and photos in one place.
home.bulletTogether: Invite relatives with roles that match how they help in the kitchen.
home.bulletLanguages: Recipes can be written in several languages; the app works in English, Finnish, Russian, and Ukrainian.
home.inviteHint: Already have an invitation? Open the link in that email after you sign in.

addPhoto.title: Add a photo
addPhoto.description: After you save a recipe, its page offers “Add photos”. A photo of the dish or of a handwritten card both work.

invite.title: Invite your family
invite.description: Send relatives an invitation so they can read and add recipes too.

roleDescriptions.owner: Can do everything, including managing members and handing the family over to someone else.
roleDescriptions.admin: Can add and edit all recipes, invite people and change what other members can do.
roleDescriptions.editor: Can add and edit all family recipes.
roleDescriptions.contributor: Can add recipes and edit the ones they added.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Can read recipes but not change them.
